note: The public lists Blokvane's list is made from. Only lists whose license allows use in a paid product, with a credit line, are here. The ad, tracker and cookie-notice lists themselves are named in filters.js (AS_LISTS), the extension's own compiler; this file names them for the credits and lists the security sources the robot reads (part: security). Not used, on purpose: URLhaus and other abuse.ch data (free only for not-for-profit use), HaGeZi's lists and malware-filter's (made partly from feeds that do not allow free commercial use), Block List Project (copies those).
